Library: mock vs app

Signed mocks on the left, today's app on the right. Both at 402 x 874 points, light theme. App shots are from the current branch on the iPhone 17 simulator with seeded demo data, so titles, percentages and counts are seed data.

Library shelfEmpty LibraryEpisode playerPDF readerA capture noteArticle tile on the shelfArticle reader, line selectedAdd note from a highlightCapture note from an article

On a phone each image scrolls sideways to show it full size.

Library shelf

Q6 mock
  • No Continue row on top and no mini player bar. The app has neither because no session is playing and the hook does not build one.
  • Filter chips show only types that exist (All, Books, Articles, PDFs). The mock also has Episodes and Talks. The shelf hook and the episode hook cannot run together, so no episode tile here.
  • Tiles: the app shows an author or site line under each title and no type badge on audiobook covers (ARTICLE and PDF badges are present). The mock badges every cover.
  • The note pill is a solid dark capsule in the app. The dashed purple ring in the mock is a 'new' marker, not UI.
  • Tab bar is the floating iOS 26 glass bar, the mock draws a flat bar. The round feedback button at the bottom right is a Dev-build extra.

Empty Library

Q6 mock
  • Closest match of the set. Heading, four doors, order and footnote text are the same words.
  • App rows have no dashed frame (that is the mock's 'new' marker). The ePub or PDF icon has no folded corner. Tab bar is the floating glass one.

Episode player

Q6 mock
  • Biggest gap. The seeded episode has no transcript, so the app shows 'Listen now, read along later / Start transcribing' where the mock shows the read-along text.
  • App header is one compact row (small cover, title, ...). The mock puts a large cover and the full title above the text.
  • Transport: app 15 and 30 second skips with a purple play button (paused). Mock 15 and 15 with a black pause button (playing).
  • Bottom card: app says 'No notes yet' because the seed has none. Mock says '2 notes from this episode'. Aa, Add note, 1x and sleep row match.

PDF reader

Q6 mock
  • The app draws the real PDF page (white, small serif, wide margins). The mock shows a larger reflowed page on a warm card.
  • Selection menu in the app: Copy and Add note. The mock also has Highlight.
  • Bottom card: app 'No notes yet', mock '3 notes from this PDF'. Footer 'p. 4 of 18' and Add note match.
  • Navigation title is larger and bolder in the app.

A capture note

Q6 mock, book quote
  • No hook makes a book capture note, so the app side is the article capture note (Q351 hook). Same screen type, different source.
  • App title is an empty greyed placeholder, filled from the quote. The mock shows a typed title and your own words under the quote.
  • App shows extra lines the mock lacks: 'Not rated' pill, an orange 'starts fading 13 Nov' line, and 'Article quote' in the date row.
  • The Back to it chip and the quote bar look the same. Navigation uses glass buttons with a + in the app.

Article tile on the shelf

Q351 mock
  • Cover colour, mono site label and serif title match, and the ARTICLE badge is there today.
  • App adds a byline under the title ('Anil Dash', 'Martin Kleppmann, Adam Wigg...'). The mock shows the title only.
  • No Continue row, chips or mini player in the app. '1 min read' against '41 min read' is seed data.
  • Covers carry a soft shadow in the app.

Article reader, line selected

Q351 mock
  • Header block (site, title, byline, date, read time, Original page) matches in order and colour.
  • No Copy, Highlight, Add note menu over the selection in the app. The hook selects text without a touch, so the menu is unverified rather than missing.
  • Selection is the system blue with handles. The mock uses a flat blue wash.
  • Progress line under the status bar appears once you have scrolled (a short purple line at 3%). At 0% it is absent. Mock shows 31%.
  • Body type is slightly looser in the app. The mock headings are a little heavier.

Add note from a highlight

Q351 mock
  • Near match: header, Not rated pill, 'Your highlight.', quote card, link-back card, hint and Record button.
  • App quote text is smaller and the whole block sits tighter. The header sits lower because of the real status bar.
  • App link line drops the mock's '(pick 3)' remark. 29% against 31% is seed data.

Capture note from an article

Q351 mock
  • Quote frame and 'Back to it at 29% in Library' chip match the mock.
  • App title is a greyed placeholder from the quote. The mock shows 'The network is optional' and your typed words below.
  • App adds 'Article quote' in the date row, a Not rated pill and an orange 'starts fading' line. The mock has none of them.
  • No tab bar in the app because the note is pushed. The mock keeps the bar.

Not captured

  • Share a PDF from Mail (Q6) and Share an article, Article or Note (Q351)The share sheet only runs inside another app's share sheet. No launch hook reaches it, and the Safari share UI test cannot find the Share button on iOS 27.
  • A note with a PDF (Q6)No hook creates a typed note with an attached PDF.
  • Episode shelf tile and transcript read-alongThe shelf hook and the episode hook are exclusive, and the seeded episode has no transcript.
  • Capture note for a book or PDFOnly the article capture note and the 'Send to a note' link card have hooks.

Branch wt/lib-compare. Pairs are in plan/reads/library-tab/compare-*.png.
